notes.title: Resolution Expansion Update
notes.content: Resolution Expansion Update: The game, which previously supported only FHD (1920x1080), has now been updated to support all resolutions.

notes.title: TheDawn has been nominated for MWU KR Award 2021 - Best Student!
notes.content:
Hello. Steam users, we bring you the latest news about Dawning.

[h2]TheDawn has been nominated for MWU KR Award 2021 - Best Student! [/h2]
MWU is a collection of various works made with Unity. Now [b]you all become the judges[/b] and participate in the Top 12 selection! The voting is available [b]every day for 18 days[/b], and you can get [b] a bountiful gift[/b] through a lottery!

We were able to come this far thanks to your interest and love. Thank you again!

http://www.unitysquare.co.kr/madewith/mwu/mwutop36

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39221233/90f5cb5c9b778f2588e27a0901ab6c84e221049d.png[/img]

notes.title: Large Translation Update
notes.content:
Old: Korean, English, Japanese, Turkish
New: French, Chinese, Russian, Brazilian, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian

The last post-support update for TheDawn.
Please continue to support and look forward to our individual development team's actions.
Thank you always!

notes.title: Notice of primary bug fixes and translations
notes.content:
Bug fix update
Bug fix that was ignored when using the Ultimate Motion during TimeRecall
Bug fix that Right after the release of the boss's death, when using TimeRecall, it fell to the floor.
Endless fall when falling through the floor -> changed to die immediately below a certain height




-----------------------------------
Thank you for topping the list of popular new products.
Without your interest and love, it would never have been possible.
This game is not scheduled to be updated in the future, but will continue to be added to the translation by December only. If anyone is interested, please contact us via email.
